AI.method: 本文采用两种互补的数学框架：(1) 在指定闭曲面上的秩一扇区分解设置中，通过比较过渡函数与独立基变换生成的过渡函数构造商结构，提取混合Chern类；同时引入Gauss-Codazzi曲率刻画动量依赖的扇区标签混合，并在标签守恒极限下用交叉Thouless泵浦度量混合类。(2) 在仅指定因子维数p和q的设置中，通过S4上秩pq丛的clutching映射计算product frame的缠绕数，建立C2可整除性与全局因子分解可行性的等价条件。
AI.result: 核心结果为：在扇区分解设置下，商结构消除行/列可加Chern数据后得到混合Chern类；在仅指定维数的设置下，全局因子分解可行的充要条件为第二Chern数C2被gcd(p,q)整除，且奇数C2必然阻碍2×2因子分解。文中通过有限八能级哈密顿量对两种场景进行了具体演示。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了占据多重态张量积分解的完整拓扑障碍理论，将全局因子分解的可行性精确定位到Chern数的可整除性条件，并通过明确的哈密顿量模型和可操作的实验协议验证了理论预测。

title: Iterative linear quadratic regulator on SU(N) for multi-qubit gate synthesis
summary: In quantum optimal control theory, gradient-based trajectory optimization techniques have proven versatile in designing multi-qubit quantum gates. Furthermore, incorporating the underlying Lie-group structure can accelerate the optimization process. In this work, we adapt the Lie-group formulation of the iterative linear quadratic regulator (iLQR) to the special unitary group SU(N) and apply it to quantum gate synthesis, systematically comparing it against the standard Euclidean iLQR formulation across multiple two- to five-qubit gates. We find that in the idealized, unconstrained setting, where all Lie-algebra basis elements are available as drive Hamiltonian terms, the Lie-group formulation converges faster than the Euclidean iLQR formulation. If drive terms are constrained to 2-local Hamiltonian terms, the Lie-group variant converges faster in early optimization iterations, but exhibits greater sensitivity to initialization and a stronger tendency towards local minima. These results demonstrate that incorporating Lie-group geometry into iLQR substantially improves convergence and highlight important next steps for improvements in constrained control settings.

AI.tldr: 本文将迭代线性二次调节器(iLQR)推广到特殊酉群SU(N)的Lie群结构上，用于量子门合成，并与标准欧几里得iLQR在2到5量子比特门上进行系统比较。在无约束理想条件下，Lie群公式收敛更快；在受2-局域哈密顿量约束时，Lie群变体在早期迭代中收敛更快，但对初始化和局部极小值更敏感。
AI.motivation: 量子最优控制中的梯度下降轨迹优化方法在设计多量子比特量子门时已被证明是灵活有效的，但融入底层Lie群结构可以进一步加速优化过程。作者希望通过将iLQR适应到SU(N)群结构上，系统地评估Lie群几何建模相对于标准欧几里得公式的收敛优势。
AI.method: 将Lie群公式iLQR扩展到特殊酉群SU(N)，应用于量子门合成任务；在多个2至5量子比特门上进行系统比较，分别考察无约束（所有Lie代数基元可作为驱动哈密顿量项）和约束（仅2-局域哈密顿量项）两种设置下的收敛性能。
AI.result: 无约束理想化设置下，Lie群公式比欧几里得iLQR收敛更快。在约束为2-局域哈密顿量项时，Lie群变体在早期优化迭代中收敛更快，但对初始化表现出更大敏感性，且更倾向于陷入局部极小值。
AI.conclusion: 将Lie群几何融入iLQR能显著改善量子门合成的收敛性能，但在受约束控制设置下仍存在改进空间，这对后续研究指明了方向。

title: Bimodal non-Gaussian photonic states from a single quantum emitter in a waveguide
summary: We investigate the generation of deterministic and heralded non-Gaussian states of light, using a single two-level system coupled to a chiral waveguide. We study the case of a single two level system driven by pulsed coherent and squeezed drive in a chiral waveguide. For coherent input pulses, we show that the emitter can deterministically generate Wigner-negative states, albeit of limited rank. Going beyond, using squeezed-vacuum inputs, we show that the interaction produces bimodal non-Gaussian states from which higher-stellar-rank states, including large squeezed cat states, can be experimentally extracted with a substantial success rate. Motivated by experimental implementations, we further analyze the effect of imperfect coupling and of the intrinsic $50\%$ collection limit of symmetric, non-chiral waveguides. Finally, we propose a simple interferometric scheme that recovers an effectively chiral interaction in an otherwise bidirectional waveguide.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了利用手性波导中单个二能级系统确定性生成和宣告式生成光的非高斯态。相干脉冲输入可确定性生成Wigner负态但秩有限；压缩真空输入可产生双模非高斯态，从中能以较高成功率提取高阶恒星秩态（包括大压缩猫态）。文中还分析了非理想耦合、对称波导50%收集极限的影响，并提出一种恢复有效手性相互作用的干涉方案。
AI.motivation: 非高斯光态是连续变量量子信息处理的关键资源，但现有生成方法通常效率低或概率性。利用手性波导中单量子发射体的确定性相互作用，探索高效生成高阶非高斯态（特别是Wigner负态和高恒星秩态）的可行途径。
AI.method: 理论分析单个二能级系统在手性波导中分别受相干脉冲和压缩真空驱动的过程。对比两种输入下的输出态结构：相干输入产生确定性Wigner负态（秩受限）；压缩真空输入产生双模非高斯态，可通过条件测量提取高阶恒星秩态。同时分析非理想耦合、对称波导的50%收集损耗，并提出干涉方案将双向波导转换为有效手性相互作用。
AI.result: 相干脉冲输入可确定性产生Wigner负态但状态秩有限；压缩真空输入能产生双模非高斯态，从中可提取包括大压缩猫态在内的高恒星秩态，且成功率可观。手性耦合优于对称波导，但可通过干涉方案克服双向波导的50%收集限制。
AI.conclusion: 该方案为实验上生成高阶非高斯光态提供了可行路径，手性波导平台结合压缩输入和条件测量可高效产生压缩猫态等高阶量子资源，干涉方案降低了对手性波导的硬件要求。

title: DAMPyF: a Python implementation of the DAMPF method for the simulation of open-system dynamics
summary: DAMPyF is an open-source Python implementation of the dissipation-assisted matrix product factorization (DAMPF) method, a tensor-network-based approach for the numerically exact simulation of finite-dimensional quantum systems coupled to bosonic environments. The method relies on a pseudomode representation of structured reservoirs and a matrix-product-state representation of the density matrix of the extended system, comprising the system and the pseudomodes. DAMPyF currently provides two workflows. First, it supports excitation energy-transfer dynamics within the single-system-excitation manifold, in which a system excitation is propagated in time. Second, it provides a high-level workflow tailored to molecular spectroscopy, in which the system levels represent electronic states and optical coherences are propagated for the subsequent computation of linear spectra, including absorption and circular dichroism. This paper describes the physical model, the DAMPF algorithm, the user-facing code structure, installation and execution, input and output formats, and minimal examples.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了DAMPyF，一个开源的Python实现，用于耗散辅助矩阵乘积分解（DAMPF）方法，该方法基于张量网络实现对耦合到玻色子环境的有限维量子系统的数值精确模拟，提供激发能量转移动力学和分子光谱计算两种工作流程。
AI.motivation: 精确模拟有限维量子系统与玻色子环境的耦合是量子动力学中的重要问题，需要开发高效的数值方法及其开源软件实现，以支持量子物理和分子光谱等领域的研究。
AI.method: 该方法利用结构化储库的赝模表示和扩展系统（系统加赝模）密度矩阵的矩阵乘积态表示。DAMPyF提供两种工作流程：一是在单系统激发子空间内传播系统激发以实现激发能量转移动力学；二是面向分子光谱学的高层工作流程，其中系统能级代表电子态，传播光学相干性以计算线性光谱（包括吸收光谱和圆二色谱）。
AI.result: DAMPyF作为开源Python包提供DAMPF算法的实现，包含物理模型、算法、用户代码结构、安装与执行指南、输入输出格式及最小示例。
AI.conclusion: DAMPyF为量子开放系统动力学和分子光谱模拟提供了一个可访问、开源的数值精确工具，扩展了DAMPF方法在量子动力学和光谱计算中的应用范围。

title: Fidelity-Based Robustness Margins for Finite-Time Quantum Control
summary: We develop a structure-specific fidelity-threshold robustness margin for finite-dimensional closed quantum systems under piecewise-constant coherent control. A scalar physical parameter may perturb the drift, a control Hamiltonian, or another declared Hamiltonian component across the control horizon. A differential sensitivity bound for trace-amplitude gate fidelity yields a threshold-dependent Lipschitz constant on the connected safe parameter component and hence a certified finite perturbation radius. Recentering this certificate produces an iterative one-dimensional method that takes certified safe steps toward the first fidelity-threshold boundary in either parameter direction. A three-qubit gate-control example shows that these finite margins vary by up to a factor of three across controllers of comparable nominal fidelity and contain structure-dependent information not captured by nominal differential sensitivity alone.

AI.tldr: 本文针对有限维封闭量子系统在分段常数相干控制下，提出了一种结构特定的保真度阈值鲁棒性余量。通过微分灵敏度界得到阈值依赖的Lipschitz常数，进而获得可认证的有限扰动半径，并以此为迭代步长开发了一维搜索方法。三量子比特门控示例表明该有限余量在不同控制器间可相差三倍，包含名义微分灵敏度无法捕捉的结构依赖信息。
AI.motivation: 量子控制在实际应用中不可避免地受到物理参数扰动的干扰，现有的鲁棒性分析通常仅基于名义微分灵敏度（局域信息），无法为保真度阈值提供可认证的有限扰动范围。需要一个结构特定的、可认证的鲁棒性余量来量化控制器在实际扰动下的可靠性。
AI.method: 针对分段常数相干控制的有限维封闭量子系统，基于trace-amplitude守真度建立微分灵敏度界，推导出阈值依赖的Lipschitz常数，定义连通安全参数分量上的可认证有限扰动半径；通过最近化该证书，构建迭代一维方法，在朝向保真度阈值边界的方向上以认证安全步长前进。
AI.result: 三量子比特门控示例表明，结构特定的有限扰动余量在名义保真度相近的不同控制器之间可相差高达三倍，且这些余量包含名义微分灵敏度无法捕获的结构依赖信息，验证了该方法的区分能力与实用性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为量子控制器的鲁棒性提供了一种超越局域灵敏度的、可认证的有限扰动余量，并能支持向阈值边界的迭代搜索，为量子门设计的鲁棒性评估和优化提供了新的结构感知工具。

title: Inverse Design of Quantum Control Sequences with Fourier Neural Operators
summary: Quantum optimal control is a key tool for steering quantum dynamics, but its computational cost grows rapidly with the Hilbert space dimension. Here, we introduce a Fourier Neural Operator (FNO)-based framework for learning high dimensional molecular quantum dynamics and accelerating the inverse design of control protocols. Given an initial molecular population distribution, laser frequency, and polarization, the FNO predicts molecular-motional population dynamics up to $10^7$ times faster than GPU-accelerated numerical propagation with CUDA-Q Dynamics. Using this fast and differentiable surrogate, we develop the FNO stochastic pulse-measurement planner (FNO-SPMP), which constructs pulse sequences to purify an initially mixed Boltzmann distribution. We demonstrate the protocol in an 888-dimensional subspace of the hydronium molecule at 20 K, achieving a target-state population of 0.98 with a sequence success rate of up to 86.2%. In a shared discrete control space, FNO-SPMP achieves nearly twice the success rate of a reinforcement-learning baseline while using roughly half as many quantum control pulses and reducing pulse-sequence generation time from approximately 10 hours to 10-20 minutes. These results show that operator-learning surrogates can enable inverse design in quantum systems whose Hilbert spaces are too large for conventional direct optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于傅里叶神经算子（FNO）的框架，用于学习高维分子量子动力学并加速控制协议的逆设计。FNO预测分子运动种群动力学的速度比GPU加速的数值传播快10^7倍，并基于此开发了FNO随机脉冲测量规划器（FNO-SPMP），在水合氢离子的888维子空间中实现目标态布居0.98，序列成功率达86.2%，性能优于强化学习基线。
AI.motivation: 量子最优控制是操纵量子动力学的关键工具，但其计算成本随希尔伯特空间维度的增长而急剧增加。对于高维量子系统，传统直接优化方法的计算代价过高，亟需一种加速逆设计方案的方法。
AI.method: 提出FNO-based框架：1）构建傅里叶神经算子作为可微代理模型，以初始分子种群分布、激光频率和偏振为输入，预测分子运动种群动力学；2）基于该快速可微代理，开发FNO随机脉冲测量规划器（FNO-SPMP），构造脉冲序列将初始混合Boltzmann分布纯化到目标态。
AI.result: FNO预测速度比GPU加速的CUDA-Q Dynamics数值传播快10^7倍。在水合氢离子888维子空间、20 K条件下，目标态布居达到0.98，序列成功率达86.2%。在共享离散控制空间中，FNO-SPMP的成功率约为强化学习基线的两倍，脉冲序列生成时间从约10小时缩短至10-20分钟，且使用的量子控制脉冲数量约为其一半。
AI.conclusion: 算子学习代理模型能够实现对希尔伯特空间过大而无法进行传统直接优化的量子系统的逆设计，为高维量子控制提供了可行的加速路径。

title: Entanglement Distillation of some Rank-Five Symmetric NPT States in Two-Qutrit Systems
summary: Entanglement distillation is a fundamental task in quantum information processing. In this work, we investigate the distillability properties of a class of two-qutrit symmetric NPT states of rank five. We resolve the 1-distillability problem for this class by proving that the previously open interval of the eigenvalue parameter is 1-undistillable. For the 2-distillability, we uncover a structural obstruction showing that no Schmidt-rank-two vector has a negative expectation in the relevant subspace. We also perform numerical investigations to explore the 2-distillability beyond this obstruction.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一类秩为五的两-qutrit对称NPT态的蒸馏性质，解决了该类的1-可蒸馏问题（证明此前开放的参数区间是1-不可蒸馏的），并揭示了2-可蒸馏的结构性障碍（不存在在相关子空间中具有负期望的Schmidt秩为二的向量），同时通过数值研究探索了该障碍之外的2-可蒸馏性。
AI.motivation: 纠缠蒸馏是量子信息处理中的基本任务，理解哪些纠缠态可以被蒸馏对于量子通信和量子计算至关重要。此前一类两-qutrit对称NPT态（秩为五）的蒸馏性质存在开放问题，特别是1-可蒸馏性在某个特征值参数区间内尚未解决，2-可蒸馏性也不清楚，需要给出完整的刻画。
AI.method: 通过数学证明解决1-蒸馏性问题（证明开放参数区间为1-不可蒸馏）；通过揭示结构性障碍研究2-蒸馏性（即证明不存在Schmidt秩为二的向量在该相关子空间中具有负期望值）；并辅以数值计算探索结构性障碍之外的2-可蒸馏行为。
AI.result: 1) 完全解决了该类态的1-可蒸馏性问题，证明此前开放的参数区间是1-不可蒸馏的；2) 发现了2-可蒸馏的结构性障碍：没有任何Schmidt秩为二的向量能在相关子空间中产生负期望值；3) 通过数值研究进一步探索了超越此障碍的2-可蒸馏性质。
AI.conclusion: 该工作完整刻画了这类两-qutrit对称NPT态的可蒸馏性边界，为理解高维系统中的纠缠蒸馏提供了新的理论洞察，特别是揭示了结构限制在2-蒸馏中的作用。

title: Preserving Symmetry: Spontaneous Symmetry Breaking through Decoherence
summary: Solids appear to have localised centres of mass, yet many-body quantum theory describes them using translationally symmetric models that preclude localisation. Conventionally, this is resolved through spontaneous symmetry breaking by introducing an interaction with a semiclassical environment that breaks the symmetry. In the thermodynamic limit, the interaction can be removed while leaving the state localised. This, however, raises the question of how localisation arises outside the thermodynamic limit, i.e., in finite quantum systems (Wallace, 2018). Here, we show that, by quantising the environment, the localisation of finite systems occurs within decoherent branches, while the state vector of the composite system remains translationally symmetric. Our approach is analogous to the Page-Wootters construction (Page & Wootters, 1983) and quantum reference frames; moreover, we recover the semiclassical description as a limiting case while predicting experimentally distinguishable corrections away from this limit.

AI.tldr: 本文通过量子化环境，证明有限量子系统中固体的定域化发生在退相干分支内，而复合系统的态矢量仍保持平移对称，其方法类比Page-Wootters构造与量子参考系，并可在远离半经典极限时产生实验可分辨的修正。
AI.motivation: 固体表现出局域化的质心，但多体量子理论用平移对称模型描述固体，无法直接产生局域化。传统解决方案通过自发对称破缺引入半经典环境，且仅在热力学极限下可移除环境交互。这引发了有限量子系统（非热力学极限）中局域化如何产生的问题。
AI.method: 将环境量子化，使其与固体系统形成复合系统。系统的定域化在退相干分支内出现，而复合系统的整体态矢量保持平移对称。方法类比Page-Wootters构造和量子参考框架，半经典描述作为极限情况被恢复。
AI.result: 有限量子系统中，固体的局域化可以在量子化环境的退相干分支内自然产生，同时保持复合系统态矢量的平移对称性。远离半经典极限时，该框架预测了实验可区分的修正效应。
AI.conclusion: 通过类比量子参考系和Page-Wootters构造，该工作为有限量子系统中国体局域化问题提供了新的解决途径，将半经典自发对称破缺描述作为一般量子框架的极限情形，并给出可实验检验的偏离预言。

title: Uncovering Non-Gaussianity through Multi-Copy Symmetries
summary: Gaussian states are fundamental in continuous-variable quantum information, yet characterizing non-Gaussianity remains challenging due to the non-convexity of the Gaussian set. Existing witnesses typically rely on Wigner negativity or other information-theoretic quantities. In this work, we develop a group-theoretic, multi-copy approach to detect non-Gaussianity in bosonic systems. We study passive linear optical transformations that mix copies of a quantum state and analyze their commutation with identical Gaussian unitaries applied to each copy. Orthogonal copy-mixing transformations commute with the symplectic part of the Gaussian action, while the displacement part restricts the symmetry to the stabilizer of the collective mode. This structure yields a family of witnesses satisfied by all single-mode Gaussian states. Fixing the thermal reference parameter via the purity, violation of these identities certifies non-Gaussianity. We illustrate the method with several single-mode examples and present an experimental protocol based on passive interferometry and photon-number-resolved detection, showing that the relevant multi-copy expectation values can be estimated from bounded phase observables. Finally, we extend the construction to multi-mode systems and discuss how the same symmetry framework may lead to quantitative measures of non-Gaussianity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于群论和多拷贝框架的玻色子系统中非高斯性检测方法，通过研究混合量子态拷贝的被动线性光学变换与高斯幺正变换的交换性质，构造出所有单模高斯态均满足的见证子族，并可通过纯度固定热参考参数来认证非高斯性。
AI.motivation: 高斯态是连续变量量子信息中的基础态，但由于高斯集合的非凸性，表征非高斯性一直具有挑战性。现有见证子通常依赖Wigner负性或其他信息论量，缺乏统一且系统的检测框架。
AI.method: 采用群论的多拷贝方法：研究混合量子态多个拷贝的被动线性光学变换，分析其与作用于每个拷贝的相同高斯幺正变换的交换关系。正交拷贝混合变换与高斯作用的辛部分对易，而位移部分将对称性限制为集体模式的稳定化子。基于此结构推导出所有单模高斯态满足的见证子族，并通过纯度固定热参考参数实现非高斯性认证。
AI.result: 通过多个单模实例验证了该方法的有效性，并提出了基于被动干涉测量和光子数分辨探测的实验方案，证明相关多拷贝期望值可从有界相位可观测量估计。此外将构造扩展到多模系统，并讨论了利用相同对称性框架导出非高斯性定量度量的可能性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种系统的、基于对称性的非高斯性检测新框架，不依赖Wigner负性等传统量，且具备实验可行性，并为非高斯性的定量刻画开辟了新方向。

title: Optimal and Deterministic Quantum Search on the Simplex of Complete Graphs
summary: The simplex of complete graphs, also known as the first-order truncated simplex lattice, is a network of $M+1$ identical complete graphs, each with $M$ vertices, such that each clique contains an edge or bridge to every other clique. It contains $N = M(M+1)$ vertices, and previous asymptotic results using a continuous-time quantum walk to search this graph for a single marked vertex have either numerically demonstrated an optimal runtime of $O(\sqrt{N})$, or analytically proved a deterministic success probability of 1, but not both, even when the bridges are weighted. In this paper, we give the first analytical proof of optimal quantum search on this graph, proving that it occurs when the weight of the bridges equals $M$. In addition, we numerically show that the optimal runtime is achieved more broadly whenever the weight is at least $\sqrt{M}$. Furthermore, the algorithm is also deterministic when the weight scales between $\sqrt{M}$ and $M$, and this is the first example of quantum search on the simplex of complete graphs that is both asymptotically optimal and deterministic. In addition, for weights where the algorithm is nondeterministic, we give a way to find the marked vertex by inspecting neighboring vertices. Finally, while it is known that connectivity is not a reliable indicator of fast quantum search when comparing different graph families, we show that it is also unreliable within the graph family of weighted simplex of complete graphs.

AI.tldr: 本文首次解析证明了在加权完全图单纯形（first-order truncated simplex lattice）上进行量子搜索的最优性：当桥权重等于M时，算法以O(√N)的运行时达到确定性成功率1；当权重在√M到M之间时，算法既渐近最优又确定性；并给出了非确定性情况下通过检查邻居顶点来找到标记顶点的方法，同时展示了连通性在该图族内部也不能可靠预测量子搜索速度。
AI.motivation: 此前关于在完全图单纯形上进行连续时间量子行走搜索的研究存在一个缺口：要么通过数值方法证明最优运行时间O(√N)，要么解析证明确定性成功概率为1，但从未同时实现两者——即使对桥进行加权也是如此。作者旨在填补这一空白，首次解析证明该图上的最优量子搜索。
AI.method: 作者采用连续时间量子行走框架对加权完全图单纯形进行搜索分析。通过解析方法证明当桥权重等于M时算法最优且确定性；通过数值方法展示权重大于等于√M时即可达到最优运行时间；对于非确定性权重情形，提出了一种基于检查邻居顶点的恢复策略。
AI.result: （1）当桥权重等于M时，解析证明量子搜索最优（O(√N)）且确定性成功概率为1；（2）数值结果表明权重大于等于√M时即可实现最优运行时间；（3）当权重在√M和M之间时算法既渐近最优又确定性，这是该图族上首次同时具备这两个性质；（4）非确定性权重下可通过检查邻居顶点找到标记顶点；（5）证明了连通性在该图族内部也无法可靠预测量子搜索速度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次在完全图单纯形上同时实现了解析证明的最优运行时间和确定性成功概率，填补了此前研究中的关键空白。同时揭示了连通性即使在同一个图族内部也不能作为量子搜索效率的可靠指标，深化了对图结构、连通性与量子搜索性能之间关系的理解。

title: Impossibility of Perfectly Complete Many-Round Key Agreement in the QROM
summary:
This paper proves that it is impossible to construct perfectly complete quantum key agreement protocols (QKA) from quantumly secure one-way functions (OWFs) in a black-box manner.
  Specifically, consider any protocol in which Alice and Bob exchange only classical messages, make at most $q_{\mathsf{A}}$ and $q_{\mathsf{B}}$ quantum queries, respectively, to a Boolean-valued random oracle, and agree on a shared key with certainty. This paper shows that there exists an eavesdropper, given the classical messages, that can recover the shared key with certainty using $O((q_{\mathsf{A}}+q_{\mathsf{B}})^5)$ classical oracle queries. The bound is independent of the number of rounds, transcript length, key length, and oracle-domain size. Previous results only applies to two-round key agreement (Li et al. CRYPTO 26) or relies on unproven conjectures (Austrin et al. CRYPTO 22).
  GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra found this proof in a one-shot conversation and drafted a preliminary version of this paper. The authors are fully responsible for the correctness, writing and discussions of this paper.

AI.tldr: 本文证明在量子安全单向函数(OWF)的黑盒构造下，无法实现完美完整的量子密钥协商(QKA)协议。具体地，对于只交换经典消息、各自对布尔值随机预言机进行有限量子查询的Alice和Bob协议，存在窃听者仅通过监听经典消息并做O((qA+qB)^5)次经典预言机查询即可确定性地恢复共享密钥。该界限与轮数、转录长度、密钥长度和预言机域大小无关，优于此前仅适用于两轮协议或依赖未证猜想的结果。
AI.motivation: 此前的量子密钥协商(QKA)不可能性结果存在局限：Li等人的结果(CRYPTO 26)仅适用于两轮密钥协商协议，而Austrin等人的结果(CRYPTO 22)依赖于未经验证的猜想。需要一个通用的、不依赖于具体轮数限制和未证猜想的不可能性证明，以回答QKA协议是否可以从量子安全OWF黑盒构造这一根本性问题。
AI.method: 论文考虑任何只交换经典消息、Alice和Bob分别对布尔值随机预言机进行qA和qB次量子查询的QKA协议。通过构造窃听者，使其仅利用截获的经典消息作为线索，对随机预言机进行O((qA+qB)^5)次经典查询，即可确定性地恢复双方共享的密钥。
AI.result: 证明了无法从量子安全OWF以黑盒方式构造完美完整的QKA协议。窃听者恢复密钥所需的经典预言机查询次数为O((qA+qB)^5)，该上界独立于轮数、转录长度、密钥长度和预言机域大小，显著推广了此前的结果。
AI.conclusion: 黑盒量子安全OWF不足以构造完美完整的QKA协议，即使允许经典消息交换和多轮交互。这一不可能性结果填补了此前研究的空白，并可能引导研究者探索无需黑盒归约或更强密码学假设的QKA构造方案。

title: CNOT-Distance is NP-complete under all-to-all connectivity
summary: Given $A\in\operatorname{GL}(N,2)$ and an integer $K$, we ask whether $A$ can be implemented by at most $K$ CNOT gates on fixed labelled wires with all-to-all connectivity. We prove that this problem is NP-complete. From a finite simple graph $G=(V,E)$, we construct an upper-unitriangular matrix $A_G\in\operatorname{GL}(2|V|+|E|+1,2)$ satisfying $\ell_{\mathrm{CNOT}}(A_G)=2|V|+2|E|+τ(G)$, where $τ(G)$ is the minimum vertex-cover size. Each target matrix has $O(N)$ nonzero entries and row Hamming weight at most four. The lower bound unfolds an arbitrary CNOT circuit into an XOR directed acyclic graph and applies projection--contraction operations, allowing cancellation and unrestricted reuse of intermediate parities. For this family, the optimum is unchanged by any finite number of clean or borrowed ancillary wires that must be restored. A polynomial-time decoder further yields NP-hardness of approximation within every fixed additive constant and, through an L-reduction from Minimum Vertex Cover on cubic graphs, APX-hardness of the associated CNOT-circuit optimisation problem.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了在固定标记线且全连接拓扑下，判断一个GL(N,2)矩阵能否用至多K个CNOT门实现的问题是NP完全的。作者从有限简单图G构造上三角幺模矩阵A_G，使得其CNOT门数恰好为2|V|+2|E|+τ(G)（τ(G)为最小顶点覆盖大小），并进一步证明该CNOT电路优化问题的近似问题是APX困难的。
AI.motivation: CNOT电路综合是量子编译中的核心问题，理解最小化CNOT门数的计算复杂度对于量子电路优化具有重要意义。此前对该问题复杂性的认识不完整，需要通过严格证明来确定其计算难度的边界。
AI.method: 作者采用归约方法：从有限简单图G构造特定的上三角幺模矩阵A_G∈GL(2|V|+|E|+1,2)，该矩阵具有O(N)个非零元素且每行Hamming权重最多为4。下界证明通过将任意CNOT电路展开为XOR有向无环图，并应用投影-收缩（projection-contraction）操作，允许取消和自由重用中间奇偶校验值。此外，通过多项式时间解码器获得固定加性常数内的近似NP困难性，并通过从三次图上的最小顶点覆盖进行L-归约建立APX困难性。
AI.result: 作者证明CNOT门数最小化问题（给定矩阵A和整数K，判断是否可用至多K个CNOT门实现）是NP完全的。构造的矩阵族中，最优CNOT门数与图的最小顶点覆盖大小精确对应，且该最优值不受有限数量的干净或借用辅助线的添加而改变。由于三次图上最小顶点覆盖问题为APX困难，通过L-归约得出CNOT电路优化问题为APX困难。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确定了CNOT电路综合问题在精确求解下为NP完全，在近似层面为APX困难，为量子电路编译中CNOT优化算法的设计与复杂度边界分析提供了坚实的理论基础。

title: Separable States Violate the Complementary-Quantum Correlation Conjecture
summary: Correlations measured in complementary local bases provide an experimentally accessible probe of the total correlations in a bipartite quantum state. The complementary-quantum correlation conjecture asserts that the sum of two such classical mutual informations never exceeds the premeasurement quantum mutual information. We disprove this conjecture in every local dimension $d\geq3$ with an explicit rank-two separable state. One of the two complementary measurements recovers the complete one-bit branch label, while the other retains additional classical correlation. For qutrits the excess is exactly $\frac13\log_2(3456/3125)=0.0484156759\ldots$ bits. Continuity yields full-rank separable violations. The effect therefore requires neither entanglement nor quantum discord; it arises from two complementary readouts of the same classical latent variable.

AI.tldr: 本文否证了互补量子相关猜想（complementary-quantum correlation conjecture），该猜想认为在互补局部基下测量的两个经典互信息之和不会超过量子互信息。作者在所有维度d≥3中构造了显式的秩二可分离态作为反例，在qutrit情形下超出量精确为(1/3)log₂(3456/3125)≈0.0484 bits。该效应不需要纠缠或量子失协，而是源于对同一经典潜变量的两种互补读出。
AI.motivation: 互补基测量提供了一种实验上可访问的双粒子量子态总关联探针。此前学界普遍认为两个互补基下的经典互信息之和不会超过预测量的量子互信息，这一直觉性的猜想若成立将为量子关联的测量提供简洁的上界。作者旨在检验并挑战这一猜想。
AI.method: 作者通过构造一个显式的秩二可分离量子态作为反例。该态的设计使得其中一个互补测量能完全恢复单比特分支标签，而另一个互补测量保留额外的经典关联。在qutrit情形下精确计算出超出量为(1/3)log₂(3456/3125)比特。利用连续性论证，作者进一步将反例推广到满秩可分离态。
AI.result: 在任意局部维度d≥3下，均找到了违反该猜想的显式可分离态。qutrit情形下超出量为(1/3)log₂(3456/3125)=0.0484156759比特。通过连续性论证，满秩可分离态也能实现违反。关键发现是：该效应既不依赖纠缠也不需要量子失协，仅源于对同一经典潜变量的两个互补读出。
AI.conclusion: 互补量子相关猜想在所有维度d≥3下被证伪。关联的超额部分完全来自经典来源——同一经典潜变量在不同互补基下的读出差异，而非任何量子关联资源。这一结果修正了人们对互补测量与量子互信息关系的理解。

title: Geometric-Symmetry Logical Gate and Local-Probe Selectivity in the Three-Leg AKLT Ladder
summary: Symmetry-protected topological (SPT) phases provide a platform for encoding quantum information in protected boundary degrees of freedom. Here we study the three-leg Affleck-Kennedy-Lieb-Tasaki (AKLT) ladder as an exactly solvable SPT system with on-site symmetry $SO(3)\times \mathbb{Z}_2$. Using an exact matrix product state construction, we characterize the symmetry action on the edge encoding space and the accessibility of this space by local operators. We find that the continuous $SO(3)$ symmetry induces boundary rotations, while the leg-exchange symmetry generates a geometry-dependent logical permutation of edge qubits. Furthermore, by introducing a distinguishability measure motivated by the Knill--Laflamme condition, we derive a symmetry-resolved decay law for local accessibility. The decay is controlled by a selection rule raised from the Wigner--Eckart theorem, whereby a rank-$\ell$ local operator couples only to the $\mathcal L=\ell$ transfer-matrix sector, with a decay length determined by the corresponding correlation length. We further identify a finite-size channel that is independent of the probe operator position. These results establish a quantitative connection between SPT symmetry, lattice geometry, and the protection of boundary-encoded quantum information.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了三腿AKLT梯子这一精确可解的对称性保护拓扑（SPT）系统，利用矩阵乘积态构造刻画了边界编码空间的对称性作用与可访问性，建立了由Wigner-Eckart定理控制的对称性分辨的局部可访问性衰减定律，建立了SPT对称性、晶格几何与边界量子信息保护之间的定量联系。
AI.motivation: SPT相为在受保护边界自由度中编码量子信息提供了平台，但对称性如何具体作用于边界编码空间、局部算子如何访问这些空间以及这种访问能力如何随对称性分辨而衰减，这些问题尚未得到精确的定量理解。
AI.method: 使用精确矩阵乘积态（MPS）构造解析三腿AKLT梯子（具有SO(3)×Z₂on-site对称性）；利用Knill-Laflamme条件启发定义可区分度度量；结合Wigner-Eckart定理推导出选择定则，将秩为ℓ的局部算子耦合到L=ℓ的转移矩阵扇区；识别出与探测算子位置无关的有限尺寸通道。
AI.result: 发现连续SO(3)对称性诱导边界旋转，而腿交换对称性产生依赖几何的逻辑置换。推导出对称性分辨的局部可访问性衰减定律，其衰减由选择定则控制（秩ℓ算子仅耦合L=ℓ转移矩阵扇区），衰减长度由相应关联长度决定，并存在与算子位置无关的有限尺寸通道。
AI.conclusion: 上述结果建立了SPT对称性、晶格几何与边界编码量子信息保护之间的定量联系，为理解SPT系统中量子信息保护的机制提供了精确的理论框架。

title: Interplay between teleportation fidelity and basis-independent coherence in maximally sliced states under decoherence
summary: The influence of environmental decoherence on quantum teleportation is investigated by considering the three-qubit Maximally Sliced (MS) state as the shared entangled resource. Using the Kraus operator formalism, analytical expressions are derived for the teleportation fidelity under amplitude damping and phase damping channels. The corresponding basis-independent coherence is obtained, establishing explicit analytical relations between coherence and teleportation fidelity under both decoherence mechanisms. The results are further expressed in terms of the Coffman-Kundu-Wootters (CKW) three-tangle, thereby connecting genuine tripartite entanglement with teleportation performance. The analysis reveals distinct effects of the two noise channels: amplitude damping introduces a state-dependent threshold for achieving quantum teleportation, whereas phase damping preserves the quantum advantage until complete dephasing. These results provide a unified analytical framework for understanding the interplay among multipartite entanglement, quantum coherence and teleportation in noisy three-qubit MS states.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了环境退相干对量子隐形传态的影响，以三量子比特Maximally Sliced（MS）态为共享纠缠资源，通过Kraus算符形式推导了振幅阻尼和相位阻尼通道下的传态保真度，并建立了保真度与量子相干性及CKW三并发（three-tangle）之间的解析关系，揭示了两种噪声通道对量子传态性能的不同影响。
AI.motivation: 量子隐形传态在实际物理系统中的实现不可避免地受到环境退相干的影响，因此需要深入理解噪声如何影响传态性能。然而，多体纠缠、量子相干性与传态保真度之间的内在关联尚未被统一地解析刻画。
AI.method: 采用Kraus算符形式化方法，对三量子比特MS态分别施加振幅阻尼和相位阻尼两个退相干通道，导出传态保真度的解析表达式；同时计算与基无关的（basis-independent）相干性，并将结果进一步用CKW三-tangle表示，建立纠缠-相干-保真度三者之间的解析关系。
AI.result: 振幅阻尼通道引入了依赖于量子态参数的传态阈值，低于该阈值无法实现量子传态优势；相位阻尼通道则在完全退相干之前始终保留量子传态优势，两种噪声通道对传态性能的影响存在本质区别。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个统一的解析框架，用于理解噪声三量子比特MS态中多体纠缠、量子相干性与量子隐形传态之间的相互作用，为量子信息处理中资源评估提供了理论依据。

title: Few-photon degenerate parametric resonance in a two-tone driven microwave resonator
summary: Multi-tone external driving offers a route to parametric physics without directly modulating the device. However, the validity of the parametric response in the few-photon regime remains underexplored. Here, we apply two coherent microwave tones to a Josephson-junction Kerr oscillator and stimulate degenerate parametric downconversion via four-wave mixing. Using transmission spectroscopy, we observe that the response retains the qualitative semiclassical Kerr parametric oscillator structure, including its instability lobe and bistable phase-space topology. Interestingly, we demonstrate that a conventional single-mode reduction fails to capture the system quantitatively: the predicted AC Stark shift is severely underestimated, and the reported distributions might not be fully physical when the single-photon Kerr shift $K$ exceeds the cavity linewidth $κ$. Instead, we show that a full three-tone quantum description accurately reproduces the experimental observables. There, quantum fluctuations of the drive tones become dynamically dominant over dissipation, and all three interacting tones operate in a deep few-photon limit where the expected semiclassical macroscopic lobes undergo fundamental renormalization due to profound mixing with quantum variance. Our results establish two-tone-driven Kerr oscillators as potential parametric amplifiers and open new horizons to explore the quantum-to-classical crossover in driven-dissipative circuits.

AI.tldr: 本文研究双音驱动约瑟夫森结Kerr振荡器中的参量过程。通过四波混频激发简并参量下转换，发现系统响应保留半经典Kerr参量振荡器结构（包括失稳瓣和双稳态相空间拓扑），但常规单模约化在定量上失效（AC Stark位移被严重低估）。全三音量子描述能精确复现实验观测，三个交互音均处于深少光子极限，量子涨落动态主导耗散，使半经典宏观瓣发生根本性重整化。该结果确立了双音驱动Kerr振荡器作为参量放大器的潜力，为驱动-耗散电路中量子到经典交叉的研究开辟新方向。
AI.motivation: 研究多音外部驱动在少光子（few-photon）区域参量响应的有效性。此前，多音驱动虽为参量物理提供了一条无需直接调制器件的途径，但参量响应在极端少光子区域的正确性尚未被充分探索。作者希望理解双音驱动下Kerr振荡器的量子行为，尤其是单模约化近似何时失效，以及如何在极弱驱动下正确描述系统。
AI.method: 实验上对约瑟夫森结Kerr振荡器施加两个相干微波音，通过四波混频过程刺激简并参量下转换。利用透射光谱学观测系统的参量响应。理论上分别采用常规单模约化描述和全三音量子模型（包含三个交互音的完整量子涨落），将二者与实验观测的透射谱、AC Stark位移及光子分布进行比较。
AI.result: 实验观测显示响应保留半经典Kerr参量振荡器的定性结构（失稳瓣和双稳态相空间拓扑）。但定量上，单模约化严重低估AC Stark位移；当单光子Kerr位移K超过腔线宽κ时，单模约化给出的分布可能不具物理意义。相比之下，全三音量子描述精确复现实验可观测量。在深少光子极限下，驱动音的量子涨落动态上主导耗散，三个交互音的半经典宏观瓣因与量子方差深刻混合而发生根本性重整化。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明双音驱动的Kerr振荡器可作为参量放大器，并揭示了在驱动-耗散电路中量子到经典转变的新机制：即驱动音自身的量子涨落可成为动态主导因素。这打破了仅耗散主导量子行为的常规认识，为少光子区域的参量物理和量子-经典交叉研究提供了新的实验平台和理论框架。

title: High-level quantum structured programs as quantum registers compositions
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, Accepted for publication at IEEE International Conference on Quantum Computing and Engineering 2026 (QSYS track)
summary: Current quantum programs are mainly designed at the level of quantum gates acting on individual qubits; on a large scale and for complex problems this may involve a high cognitive load on the programmer, making the program specification nontrivial and error-prone. In this context, providing quantum programming with higher abstraction mechanisms will assist in making this task more manageable and robust against design errors. In this work, a conceptual framework is addressed following the notion of the whole quantum computation as a structure composed of quantum registers representing each an undivided entity. Thus, computation progresses through semantically well-defined transformations that act on, or entangle, quantum registers, thereby modifying the global state. Ultimately, the program reaches the desired state by following a specific composition strategy. With this in mind, high-level syntax is presented through an algebraic formalism that bridges them with their low-level semantics. Proposed syntax is based on certain well-know operations used on quantum algorithms that apply phase shifts upon logical condition satisfaction or leverage on parallel evaluation. Based solely on the formalized operations, a quantum satisfiability modulo theories (SMT) solver can be designed. At its core, this work contributes to establishing some methodological principles towards realizing a high-level quantum structured programming.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种量子计算的高层抽象框架，将量子计算视为由量子寄存器组成的整体结构，通过语义明确的变换（作用于或纠缠量子寄存器）推进计算。作者用代数形式化描述了高层语法与低层语义的桥接，并基于此设计了量子可满足性模理论（SMT）求解器，为量子结构化编程奠定方法论基础。
AI.motivation: 当前量子程序主要在量子门级别设计，大规模复杂问题上程序员认知负荷高、易出错。需要提供更高层的抽象机制，使量子编程更易于管理且对设计错误更鲁棒。
AI.method: 将整个量子计算视为由量子寄存器（每个视为不可分割的实体）组成的结构；计算通过语义明确定义的变换作用于或纠缠量子寄存器以修改全局状态，遵循特定组合策略达到目标状态。提出基于代数形式化的高层语法以桥接低层语义，语法基于量子算法中常见的操作（如条件满足时的相位偏移、并行评估）。基于形式化操作设计量子SMT求解器。
AI.result: 建立了一个高通量子计算的概念框架，包括高层语法及其代数形式化描述，并基于形式化操作成功设计了量子SMT求解器的架构。
AI.conclusion: 本工作为实现高层量子结构化编程确立了方法论原则，有助于降低量子程序设计的认知负担和错误率。

title: Exact Tradeoff Between Quantum Error Correction and Quantum Darwinism: An Information-Theoretic No-Go Theorem
summary: Quantum error correction (QEC) and Quantum Darwinism describe opposing consequences of system-environment interactions: QEC seeks to preserve logical quantum information, whereas Quantum Darwinism explains the emergence of objective classical information through its proliferation into the environment. Despite their common physical origin, no direct quantitative connection between these paradigms has previously been established. We introduce an exactly solvable block-environment model based on the logical GHZ block of the Shor [[9,1,3]] quantum error-correcting code, collectively coupled to N environment qubits. The logical fidelity, Holevo information, and Darwinistic redundancy are obtained systematically for arbitrary environment size and imperfect recovery efficiency. Eliminating the common decoherence parameter yields an exact tradeoff relating Darwinistic redundancy directly to the post-recovery logical fidelity, demonstrating that the emergence of redundant classical records occurs at the expense of logical quantum information. We further prove a model-independent no-go theorem showing that the logical fidelity exceeds a critical threshold precludes the emergence of Darwinistic redundancy, irrespective of the microscopic Hamiltonian or environment structure. The solvable model saturates this general bound, establishing the first quantitative information-theoretic connection between logical quantum information protection and the emergence of redundant classical records.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一个基于Shor [[9,1,3]]量子纠错码的逻辑GHZ块严格可解模型，首次建立了量子纠错（QEC）与量子达尔文主义之间的定量信息论联系。研究表明，冗余经典记录的出现以逻辑量子信息的丧失为代价，并证明了一个模型无关的no-go定理：逻辑保真度超过临界阈值将阻碍达尔文式冗余的出现。
AI.motivation: 量子纠错和量子达尔文主义都源于系统-环境相互作用，但分别描述了其对立后果——前者保护逻辑量子信息，后者解释客观经典信息的涌现。尽管两者物理起源相同，此前从未建立直接的定量联系，填补这一理论空白是本文的核心动机。
AI.method: 构造一个基于Shor [[9,1,3]]码的逻辑GHZ块的集体耦合块-环境模型，系统解析地计算任意环境尺寸和任意恢复效率下的逻辑保真度、Holevo信息和达尔文式冗余度；通过消去共同退相干参数导出精确的权衡关系；并证明一个与具体哈密顿量和环境结构无关的no-go定理。
AI.result: 获得了环境尺寸和恢复效率任意条件下三大量（逻辑保真度、Holevo信息、达尔文冗余度）的精确解析表达式；建立了冗余度与恢复后逻辑保真度之间的精确权衡关系；证明了逻辑保真度超过临界阈值即排除达尔文式冗余出现的no-go定理；可解模型恰好饱和该通用界。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了逻辑量子信息保护与冗余经典记录涌现之间首个定量的信息论联系，揭示了量子纠错与量子达尔文主义之间的根本性权衡，为理解量子-经典过渡提供新的理论框架。

title: Real-time decoding of quantum error correction codes using high-performance computing
summary: Quantum error correction (QEC) is indispensable for building scalable fault-tolerant quantum computers. Effective QEC demands stringent real-time decoding: the decoder must process syndrome measurements and determine corrections within a time scale--typically on the order of microseconds, to avoid data backlog. Scaling to large number of logical qubits further necessitates significant computational resources. In this work, we propose an architecture, called \emph{THQLink}, for real-time decoding of quantum error correction codes using high-performance computing (HPC) resources. The network connecting the HPC and the control system of quantum processing unit (QPU) is built on TH-Express and can be adapted to different quantum technologies and their associated control stacks. We report a round-trip latency of 2.944 $μ$s on average, with an incremental overhead of 130 ns per additional hop. Using a parallel window strategy, we demonstrate real-time decoding (1 $μ$s per QEC round) of the surface code up to distance 19 using a matching-based decoder on CPUs. Our work presents a scalable framework for real-time decoding in fault-tolerant quantum computing. It can be readily applied to quantum-centric supercomputers that feature tight integration between QPU and HPC resources, thereby enabling efficient support for hybrid quantum-classical algorithms and computation-intensive workloads offloaded from the QPU.

AI.tldr: 本文提出THQLink架构，利用高性能计算（HPC）资源实现量子纠错码的实时解码，通过TH-Express网络连接QPU控制系统与HPC，实现平均2.944μs的往返延迟，并采用并行窗口策略在CPU上完成距离19的表面码实时解码（每轮QEC 1μs）。
AI.motivation: 量子纠错（QEC）是可扩展容错量子计算的关键，但实时解码器必须在微秒级时间内处理综合征测量结果并确定纠错方案，以避免数据积压。随着逻辑量子比特数量增加，解码所需的计算资源急剧增长，传统方案难以满足实时性要求，因此需要利用HPC资源构建可扩展的实时解码框架。
AI.method: 提出THQLink架构，基于TH-Express网络将HPC与QPU控制系统集成，可适配不同量子技术和控制栈。采用并行窗口策略，在CPU上使用基于匹配的解码器（matching-based decoder）对表面码进行实时解码，通过多跳网络实现低延迟数据传输和分布式计算。
AI.result: 往返延迟平均为2.944μs，每增加一跳的增量开销为130ns；采用并行窗口策略，可在CPU上实现对距离19的表面码每轮QEC 1μs的实时解码。
AI.conclusion: THQLink提供了可扩展的实时解码框架，可直接应用于量子中心超级计算机（QPU与HPC紧密集成），为混合量子-经典算法和从QPU卸载的计算密集型工作负载提供高效支持。

title: Separating quantum circuits from classical LLMs
summary:
Modern large language models - transformers and diffusion language models - are built around two canonical algorithmic tasks: prediction and generation. We prove unconditional separations between low-depth quantum computation and the corresponding bounded-resource classical language-model architectures in both regimes. Concretely, we exhibit the following:
  1. Distributional separation. We give a distribution that is sampleable by $\textsf{QNC}^0$ circuits (i.e., a family of constant-depth quantum circuits consisting of bounded fan-in gates) that no constant-round diffusion language model ($\textsf{DLM}$) with shallow scheduling and denoising can sample within constant distance, even when allowed sublinear chain-of-thought and output-token revision/remasking events, the very features modern $\textsf{DLM}$s rely on.
  2. Functional separation. We exhibit a function computable in $\land \circ \textsf{QNC}^0[\log\log n]$ (i.e., a family of O$(\log\log n)$-depth $\textsf{QNC}^0$ circuits, where $n$ is the input length, followed by a single classical $\mathsf{AND}$ gate) such that any constant-depth decoder-only transformer computing the function must be large: it would have to have width $n^{Ω(1)}$.
  Together, our work initiates the study of quantum advantage in the era of large language models.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了低深度量子计算与有界资源经典语言模型架构（Transformer和扩散语言模型）之间不可条件分离，分别给出分布级分离和函数级分离的结果，开创了大语言模型时代量子优势的研究。
AI.motivation: 现代大语言模型基于两个核心算法任务：预测和生成。作者旨在从计算复杂度理论的角度，探究低深度量子电路是否能在这些任务上超越受资源限制的经典语言模型架构，从而开启大语言模型时代量子计算优势的正式研究。
AI.method: 通过构造具体的分布和函数来实现分离：(1) 构造一个可由QNC^0电路采样的分布，证明任何具有浅层调度和去噪的常数轮扩散语言模型（DLM），即使允许次线性思维链和输出token修订/重掩码，也无法在常数距离内采样该分布；(2) 构造一个可在log log n深度QNC^0电路后跟单个经典AND门中计算的函数，证明任何计算该函数的常数深度decoder-only Transformer必须具有n^{Ω(1)}的宽度。
AI.result: (1) 分布级分离：存在QNC^0可采样的分布，任何常数轮且浅层调度去噪的扩散语言模型无法在常数距离内采样；(2) 函数级分离：存在可由∧∘QNC^0[log log n]计算的函数，任何计算它的常数深度decoder-only Transformer需要多项式级别的宽度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作在严格的计算复杂度框架下建立了低深度量子电路相对于经典语言模型架构（无论Transformer还是扩散模型）的分离结果，开启了大语言模型时代量子优势的系统性研究。

title: A quantum game of telephone
summary: Characterizing multinode quantum networks without ubiquitous local entanglement sources presents significant experimental challenges. We introduce ``quantum telephone,'' an iterative ancilla-assisted process tomography protocol that leverages intermediate detection events, effectively treating previously probed links as ancillae for subsequent links. Implemented on a deployed multinode fiber network, we observe noisy intermediate channels create fundamental parameter degeneracies that compound inference errors under sequential estimation. Counterintuitively, the inclusion of downstream near-unitary channels provides boundary constraints that, when used in tandem with global inference, can resolve ambiguity in channels earlier in the sequence. By compensating for localized information loss, this approach obviates the strict full-rank requirements of standard ancilla-assisted process tomography, even when intermediate states become completely depolarized. Overall, quantum telephone offers a hardware-efficient and information-maximizing path toward characterizing complex quantum networks with limited resources.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"量子电话"（quantum telephone）协议，一种迭代式的辅助量子过程层析成像方法，利用中间探测事件将先前探测的链路作为辅助量子比特来表征多节点量子网络，并在部署的真实光纤网络上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 在缺乏普遍可用的局部纠缠源的情况下，表征多节点量子网络面临显著的实验挑战；标准辅助辅助过程层析成像对辅助态有严格的全秩要求，而实际噪声中间信道会导致参数简并并放大顺序估计中的推理误差。
AI.method: 提出"量子电话"协议，采用迭代式辅助辅助过程层析成像方法：将先前已探测的链路作为后续链路的辅助量子比特，利用中间探测事件传递量子信息；同时通过全局推理结合下游近酉信道的边界约束来解析序列中早期信道的模糊性，补偿局部信息损失。
AI.result: 在真实部署的多节点光纤网络上实现，观察到噪声中间信道造成的参数简并使顺序估计中的推理误差加剧；但下游近酉信道的边界约束与全局推理相结合可解决早期信道歧义；即使在中间态完全去极化的情况下也能工作，避免了对标准辅助辅助过程层析成像严格全秩要求的依赖。
AI.conclusion: 量子电话协议提供了一种硬件高效且信息最大化的路径，能够在资源有限的情况下表征复杂的量子网络，弥补了标准方法在全秩要求和局部信息损失方面的不足。

title: A lower bound on the classical simulation cost of star-network correlations
summary: It is well established that quantum strategies outperform classical ones in several communication tasks. We study the quantum communication complexity of correlations arising from joint measurements on quantum systems distributed across a star network, where several parties each send a quantum system to a central node. We introduce an exclusion task that can be solved perfectly when each party sends a quantum $d$-level system, but would require a large classical message otherwise. In fact, the task cannot be solved with certainty if each of the $n$ parties sends a classical message with less than $n^{(d-1)}$ symbols. This implies an advantage of using quantum over classical messages in that scenario that scales with both, the dimension of the quantum system and the number of systems measured simultaneously. As an application, this shows that no finite-size classical description of a qubit suffices to reproduce the statistics of a joint measurement on sufficiently many qubits.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究星型网络中的量子通信复杂度，提出了一种排他性任务，该任务在各方发送量子d维系统时可以完美解决，但若发送经典消息则需要大量符号（少于n^(d-1)个符号则无法达到确定性解决）。这展示了量子相对于经典通信的优势，其规模同时依赖于量子系统维度和同时测量的系统数量。
AI.motivation: 量子策略在通信任务中优于经典策略是众所周知的事实，但作者希望在星型网络这一特定场景下，量化量子通信相对于经典通信的优势规模，并探索这种优势是否随量子系统维度和参与方数量同时扩展。
AI.method: 论文引入了一种排他性（exclusion）任务，其中多个参与方各向中心节点发送量子系统，中心节点对接收到的系统进行联合测量。作者通过对比量子d维系统通信与经典消息通信在该任务中的可行性，推导出经典通信所需消息规模的下界。
AI.result: 该任务在各方发送量子d维系统时可完美求解，但若n方各发送经典消息且每条消息少于n^(d-1)个符号，则任务无法以确定性方式解决。这表明量子优势同时随量子系统维度d和参与方数量n扩展。作为推论，任何有限大小的经典描述都不足以在足够多的量子比特联合测量中复现其统计特性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了星型网络中量子通信在排他性任务上具有显著优势，且这种优势随系统维度和参与方数量同时增长，并揭示了量子系统统计特性无法用有限经典描述逼近的本质。

title: Realified tensor networks: quantum circuit simulation on real-valued matrix accelerators
summary: Tensor-network contraction simulates quantum circuits, but modern matrix accelerators (NPUs, TPUs) expose only real GEMM pipelines, so the complex networks of quantum simulation must be reconstructed in software. We resolve the mismatch by a realification rewrite that maps any complex tensor network to a real one. At each merge of two complex tensors, a rank-3 structure tensor realizes Gauss's three-multiplication (3M) formula; contractions with one or no complex operand need only two or one real products. We prove a tight cost law: overhead $1 + 2m + r$ in real multiplications, where $m$ and $r$ are the volume fractions of two- and one-complex-operand contractions, never exceeding $3\times$ relative to real contraction, with every intermediate at most doubled in size. On 67 circuits (random, Clifford+$T$, QAOA, VQE), the law holds across the real-to-complex range and complex-gate placement, not count, governs cost. Contraction orders transfer from the complex network with a relative arithmetic-cost gap below $5\times 10^{-4}$ on 66 of 67 circuits; the exception closes under a few steps of low-temperature simulated annealing. On an Ascend 910 NPU the rewrite beat both the four-real-GEMM baseline and a per-GEMM Gauss lowering on all twelve random circuits and on 52 of 55 structured cells (three cells slower by at most 12\%); the four-GEMM baseline was slower by a median $1.7\times$ (random) and $1.4\times$ (structured). Realification makes complex tensor-network contraction native to real-only matrix engines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种"实化重写"(realification rewrite)方法，将复数张量网络收缩映射为实数运算，使量子电路模拟能在仅支持实数GEMM的现代矩阵加速器（NPU/TPU）上高效运行。通过高斯三次乘法(3M)公式将复数收缩重构为实数网络，并在Ascend 910 NPU上验证了其优越性。
AI.motivation: 量子电路模拟依赖复数张量网络收缩，但现代矩阵加速器（如NPU、TPU）仅暴露实数GEMM流水线。复数网络需要在软件层重构为实数运算，而传统的四实数GEMM基线方法效率低下，存在性能瓶颈。本文旨在解决复数张量网络与实数硬件加速器之间的根本性失配问题。
AI.method: 提出实化重写(realification)：将任意复数张量网络映射为实数网络。具体地，合并两个复数张量时引入秩-3结构张量实现高斯三次乘法(3M)公式；对含一个或零个复数操作数的收缩只需2个或1个实数乘法。同时推导出紧致的成本定律：实数乘法开销为1+2m+r（m和r分别为双复数与单复数操作数收缩的体积分数），最坏不超过实数收缩的3倍，且每个中间张量大小至多翻倍。
AI.result: 在67个电路（随机、Clifford+T、QAOA、VQE）上验证了成本定律，且发现成本由复数门的位置决定而非数量。收缩顺序从复数网络迁移时，66/67个电路的相对算术成本差低于5×10^-4（例外可通过低温模拟退火消除）。在Ascend 910 NPU上，重写方法全面优于四实数GEMM基线和逐GEMM高斯降维方案：全部12个随机电路和52/55个结构化电路更快（3个慢至多12%）；四GEMM基线中位慢1.7×（随机）和1.4×（结构化）。
AI.conclusion: 实化重写使复数张量网络收缩成为实数矩阵引擎的原生操作，以不超过3×的乘法开销和至多2倍的中间张量代价，实现了从复数网络向实数硬件的无缝映射，为量子电路模拟在实数加速器上的高效运行提供了理论保证和实际验证。

title: Non-Relativistic Quantum Electrodynamics of Atoms in a Rotating Ring Cavity
summary: In this paper, we derive a quantum optics model in a non-inertial rotating ring cavity from first principles. We begin with the Dirac equation in curved spacetime, add minimal coupling to the electromagnetic field, and then find the Dirac Hamiltonian for the generalized Born metric. We then formally take the non-relativistic limit by way of Foldy-Wouthuysen transformations and project onto a fermionic Fock space for the atoms' electrons, protons, and neutrons. Focusing on a protium atom, we next move from a minimal coupling gauge to a multipole expansion gauge by taking a Power-Zienau-Woolley transformation under the dipole and long-wavelength approximations. Here, we find additional terms from the rotation of the system including a rotation-induced hyperfine shift of the atomic transition which could possibly be observed experimentally even for small rotation rates. Making the electric dipole, two-level, and rotating-wave approximations, we arrive at a Jaynes-Cummings-like Hamiltonian which also accounts for rotational effects, such as the rotation-induced hyperfine shift and the Sagnac shift for the cavity's counterpropagating modes.

AI.tldr: 本文从第一性原理出发，在旋转环形腔中推导了一个量子光学模型。从弯曲时空中的Dirac方程出发，加入电磁场的最小耦合，通过Foldy-Wouthuysen变换取非相对论极限，并投影到原子的费米Fock空间。对氢原子采用Power-Zienau-Woolley变换从最小耦合规范转向多极展开规范，发现旋转诱导的超精细频移，最终得到包含旋转效应的Jaynes-Cummings类哈密顿量。
AI.motivation: 旋转（非惯性）参考系中的量子光学系统具有重要的基础物理意义和应用前景，但此前缺乏从第一性原理出发的严格推导。作者旨在建立一个自洽的量子光学模型，系统地涵盖旋转对原子-腔场相互作用的影响，包括Sagnac效应和旋转诱导的超精细频移。
AI.method: 从弯曲时空中的Dirac方程出发，对广义Born度规加入电磁场最小耦合，得到Dirac哈密顿量；通过Foldy-Wouthuysen变换严格取非相对论极限；投影到电子、质子、中子的费米Fock空间；对氕原子在偶极和长波长近似下进行Power-Zienau-Woolley变换进入多极展开规范；最后在电偶极、二能级和旋波近似下得到Jaynes-Cummings类哈密顿量。
AI.result: 推导出了一个旋转环形腔中原子-腔场相互作用的完整量子光学哈密顿量。发现旋转系统引入了额外项，包括旋转诱导的原子跃迁超精细频移（即使对很小的旋转速率也可能在实验上观察到），以及腔对向传播模式的Sagnac频移。
AI.conclusion: 该工作从第一性原理建立了非惯性旋转腔中的量子光学模型，揭示旋转不仅通过Sagnac效应影响腔模，还通过旋转诱导的超精细频移影响原子内部能级结构，为旋转系统中的量子光学实验和理论提供了严格的物理基础。

title: Surface Variables Description of Axion Topological Materials
summary: We study the response of axion topological materials under the presence of external static electric and magnetic fields. We focus on the macroscopic quasi-static magnetoelectric response of topological insulators. We use techniques based on surface variables that have been previously employed in soft condensed matter problems for the description of heterogeneous systems composed of multiple homogeneous materials. A complete description of the whole system is written in terms of surface degrees of freedom, which in this case correspond to effective surface charge and surface current densities. We obtain a set of integral equations satisfied by these variables. We present exact analytic solutions for axial-symmetric cases. We develop a numerical method for the solution of the integral equations by means of a boundary finite element method. We apply the numerical method to topological insulators with different geometries such as spheres, hollow spheres and toroidal surfaces. We show that that a variational principle can be used to recover the surface variables equations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了拓扑绝缘体（轴向拓扑材料）在外部静态电场和磁场下的宏观准静态磁电响应。采用源自软凝聚态问题的表面变量技术，将整个系统用有效表面电荷和表面电流密度描述，推导出积分方程组，给出了轴对称情形的精确解析解，并发展了边界有限元数值方法应用于球体、空心球和环面等几何形状。
AI.motivation: 拓扑绝缘体在外加静电场和磁场下的磁电响应是一个重要的研究课题，但先前缺乏一种统一且完整的宏观描述框架。本文旨在利用表面变量的方法，为异质系统（由多种均匀材料组成）提供一种完整的解析与数值求解途径。
AI.method: 采用软凝聚态物理中处理异质系统的表面变量技术，将整个系统约化为表面自由度（有效表面电荷密度和表面电流密度），推导满足的积分方程；对轴对称情形给出精确解析解；发展基于边界有限元方法的数值求解方案，并应用于球体、空心球和环面等不同几何构型的拓扑绝缘体。此外，还证明了可通过变分原理恢复表面变量方程。
AI.result: 成功获得了表面电荷和表面电流密度满足的积分方程组，给出了轴对称情形的精确解析解，并通过边界有限元数值方法对球体、空心球和环面等不同几何构型的拓扑绝缘体进行了求解，验证了数值方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 表面变量的积分方程方法为拓扑绝缘体在外部静态电磁场下的磁电响应提供了一套完整且通用的描述框架，既包含精确解析解（轴对称情形），又具有可推广到任意几何的数值方法（边界有限元），同时通过变分原理建立了理论上的统一基础。

title: Collider Spin Tomography with Missing Neutrinos
summary: Missing neutrinos need not destroy collider spin tomography. We formulate the visible measurement under kinematic ambiguities arising from invisible particles as a coarse-grained positive-operator-valued measure on the production spin density matrix. We show that information loss is governed by the null space of the resulting visible-data map, not by the number of kinematic solutions. In $e^+e^-\toτ^+τ^-\toπ^+π^-+ν\barν$, the twofold ambiguity leaves only the antisymmetric spin-correlation combination $C_{nr}-C_{rn}$ unidentifiable, while the differential production rate and the remaining fourteen spin coefficients are identifiable. For practical reconstruction under kinematic ambiguities, we develop a self-consistent fixed-point unfolding method using only visible data, without assuming a theoretical production template. Closure tests in Standard Model and anomalous tau-dipole benchmarks show that the method reproduces the truth-level differential production rate and all identifiable spin coefficients, whereas the usual flat average over kinematic folds gives significantly biased reconstructions. When a nontrivial null space is present, the reconstructed identifiable subspace together with positivity yields controlled ranges for concurrence and the CHSH parameter.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在存在不可见粒子导致运动学模糊时，仍可通过将可见测量表述为生产自旋密度矩阵上的粗粒化POVM来进行自旋层析。信息损失由可见数据映射的零空间决定，而非运动学解的数量。在e+e-→τ+τ-→π+π-+νν̄过程中，二重模糊仅使反对称自旋关联组合C_nr-C_rn不可识别，其余十四项自旋系数均可识别。作者开发了仅依赖可见数据的自洽定点展开（unfolding）方法，在标准模型和反常tau偶极矩基准下均能重构真实微分产生率和所有可识别的自旋系数，优于常规的平面平均方法。
AI.motivation: 中微子等不可见粒子的存在会导致运动学模糊，可能威胁基于末态粒子动量的自旋层析测量。此前普遍认为运动学多重解会严重破坏自旋信息恢复，因此需要澄清信息损失的真实机制并发展鲁棒的实用重构方法。
AI.method: 将可见测量表达为生产自旋密度矩阵上的粗粒化POVM；通过研究可见数据映射的零空间分析信息可识别性；提出自洽定点展开方法，仅使用可见数据且无需假设理论产生模板，实现对微分产生率和自旋系数的重构。
AI.result: 运动学二重模糊仅导致C_nr-C_rn一个组合无法识别，其余十四个自旋系数可识别。定点展开方法在SM和反常tau偶极矩基准下均准确重构所有可识别量，而平面平均方法产生显著偏差。存在非平凡零空间时，可识别子空间结合正定性约束可给出纠缠度（concurrence）和CHSH参数的控制区间。
AI.conclusion: 缺失的中微子不会摧毁对撞机自旋层析；信息损失由映射零空间而非运动学解数目决定，且定点展开方法可在实践中可靠恢复可识别自旋信息。

title: de Sitter holography from a Lorentzian torus
summary: We show that the quantum entanglement between the conformal field theories (CFTs) living on the future and past boundaries in the de Sitter/conformal field theory (dS/CFT) correspondence can be described by Wick rotating to a geometry with two timelike directions. We propose a new realization of the dS/CFT correspondence in which quantum gravity on this two-time geometry is holographically dual to a CFT defined on a Lorentzian torus. We show that this duality reproduces key features of dS holography, including the dS entropy, correlation functions, and pseudoentropy. Finally, by extending the framework of path-integral optimization, we explain how dS spacetime emerges from the CFT on the Lorentzian torus.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新的dS/CFT对应实现方式：将de Sitter时空未来与过去边界上的CFT之间的量子纠缠，通过Wick旋转到具有两个类时方向的几何来描述。量子引力在该双时间几何上对偶于定义在Lorentzian环面上的CFT，该对偶能再现dS全息的关键特性（dS熵、关联函数和伪熵），并通过路径积分优化框架解释dS时空如何从Lorentzian环面上的CFT涌现。
AI.motivation: de Sitter时空的全息描述是全息原理在宇宙学背景中的重要难题。传统dS/CFT对应中，未来和过去边界上的两个CFT之间的量子纠缠缺乏清晰而严格的描述框架，需要一种新的几何构造来理解和量化这种纠缠关系。
AI.method: (1) 通过Wick旋转将dS/CFT对应的双边界CFT纠缠问题映射到具有两个类时方向的几何上；(2) 提出该双时间几何上的量子引力与定义在Lorentzian环面上的CFT之间的新全息对偶；(3) 利用该对偶计算dS熵、关联函数和伪熵；(4) 扩展路径积分优化框架，从Lorentzian环面上的CFT出发构造dS时空的涌现。
AI.result: 新提出的对偶关系成功再现了dS全息的关键特征，包括dS熵、两点关联函数以及伪熵，表明双时间几何+Lorentzian环面CFT的框架是dS/CFT对应的一致性和可计算性俱佳的实现方式。路径积分优化方法还解释了dS时空如何从CFT数据中涌现出来。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为dS全息提供了一种新的、可计算的实现方案，将未来与过去边界CFT之间的纠缠通过双时间几何自然编码，并从CFT出发展示了dS时空的涌现机制，为理解宇宙学全息原理提供了新的视角和工具。

title: Intent-Level Quantum Programming with Assertion-Guided Execution and Inspectable Intermediate Representation
summary: Quantum programs are difficult to validate: circuits are typically expressed as imperative gate sequences with limited inspectability, execution modalities must be selected manually, and outputs are inherently probabilistic. These challenges are compounded when programs must be portable across backend frameworks with differing internal conventions. We present a quantum domain-specific language (QDSL) that addresses these problems through three mechanisms: (i) intent-execution separation, where algorithmic constructs such as preparation, superposition, entanglement, and measurement are represented as inspectable objects compiled into backend-specific circuits only after pre-execution Intermediate Representation (IR) validation; (ii) first-class IR introspection, exposing circuit width, wire mapping, operation order, and measurement intent for developer inspection prior to execution; and (iii) assertion-guided modality inference, where the engine examines declared verification properties to automatically select sampling, statevector, or dual execution without user intervention. Results are logged in structured form to support reproducible regression testing. We evaluate our prototype on benchmark circuits spanning entanglement, oracle-based, structured-transform, and variational examples. In fault-injection experiments on Bell and 3-qubit GHZ circuits, a total-variation-distance detector identifies the injected faults across all evaluated shot budgets (True Positive Rate 1.0), with observed false positives (False Positive Rate 2.7-3.8%) only at 128 shots. Differential testing demonstrates numerical agreement across PennyLane and Qiskit compilation targets for the evaluated constructs after endianness canonicalization. IR generation costs are sub-millisecond.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种量子领域特定语言（QDSL），通过意图-执行分离、一等IR内省与断言引导的模式推断三个机制，解决量子程序验证与跨后端可移植性问题。在基准电路上验证了故障注入检测（TPR=1.0）、跨框架差分测试一致性及亚毫秒级IR生成开销。
AI.motivation: 量子程序的验证面临三大挑战：电路通常以命令式门序列表达、难以检查；执行模式需人工选择；输出本质上是概率性的。此外，跨不同后端框架（具有不同的内部约定）的可移植性进一步加剧了这些困难。
AI.method: 提出QDSL，包含三个机制：(i) 意图-执行分离：将制备、叠加、纠缠、测量等算法构造表示为可检查对象，仅在预执行IR验证后才编译为后端特定电路；(ii) 一等IR内省：在执行前向开发者暴露电路宽度、线映射、操作顺序和测量意图；(iii) 断言引导的模式推断：引擎根据声明的验证属性自动选择采样、statevector或双执行模式。结果以结构化形式记录以支持可复现的回归测试。
AI.result: 在纠缠、基于预言机、结构化变换和变分等基准电路上评估原型。在Bell和3-qubit GHZ电路的故障注入实验中，基于全变分距离的检测器在所有评估的shot预算下识别出注入故障（TPR=1.0），仅在128 shots时观察到假阳性（FPR=2.7-3.8%）。差分测试表明在字节序规范化后，PennyLane和Qiskit编译目标在评估构造上数值一致。IR生成成本为亚毫秒级。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的QDSL通过可检查的IR表示、程序化内省和自动执行模式推断，有效解决了量子程序验证与跨框架移植问题，在故障检测、跨后端一致性方面均达到优异性能，且编译开销极低。

title: High-Frequency Gravitational Wave Detection with Superconducting Qubits
summary: High-frequency gravitational waves (HFGWs) provide a unique window into high-energy and early-universe physics, yet they evade traditional macroscopic interferometry. To bridge this detection gap, we propose a novel quantum-sensing paradigm utilizing superconducting transmon qubits embedded in resonant microwave cavities. Through the inverse Gertsenshtein effect, HFGWs propagating in a static magnetic field resonantly excite a cavity mode. By leveraging the characteristic spin-2 quadrupolar pattern of the induced electromagnetic field, we position qubits directly at the electric-field hot spots of the $\mathrm{TE}_{212}$ mode to act as localized sensors. Crucially, configuring this array as an entangled quantum register via symmetric Dicke states unlocks a fundamental scaling advantage: the signal probability scales quadratically with the qubit number, translating to a $h_{\min} \propto n_q^{-3/4}$ strain sensitivity scaling. We demonstrate that an idealized global register of 800 qubits reaches a strain sensitivity that surpasses standard macroscopic cavity-power limits by five orders of magnitude. Benchmarked against representative axion-haloscope parameters, this collective quantum enhancement decisively mitigates the profound Planck-scale suppression inherent to gravitational interactions, establishing a transformative framework for next-generation HFGW searches in the GHz band.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用超导transmon量子比特嵌入共振微波腔的新型量子感测范式，通过逆Gertsenshtein效应探测高频引力波（HFGWs），利用Dicke纠缠态实现信号概率的二次方增益，使应变灵敏度标度达到h_min ∝ n_q^{-3/4}，800个量子比特的全局寄存器可将灵敏度提升五个数量级，突破宏观腔功率极限和Planck尺度抑制。
AI.motivation: 高频引力波（HFGWs）是探索高能和早期宇宙物理的独特窗口，但传统宏观干涉测量法无法探测此频段，存在显著的探测空白，需要新的探测范式来弥补这一差距。
AI.method: 将超导transmon量子比特嵌入共振微波腔，利用逆Gertsenshtein效应（HFGWs在静态磁场中传播时共振激发腔模），利用自旋-2四极电磁场模式在TE212模电场热点处定位量子比特，并将量子比特阵列构造成对称Dicke态纠缠量子寄存器以实现集体量子增强。
AI.result: 信号概率随量子比特数二次方增长，应变灵敏度标度为h_min ∝ n_q^{-3/4}；理想化800量子比特全局寄存器的应变灵敏度超过标准宏观腔功率极限五个数量级，有效缓解引力相互作用的Planck尺度抑制。
AI.conclusion: 该集体量子增强机制确立了GHz频段下一代高频引力波搜索的变革性框架，展示了量子纠缠资源在基础物理探测中的巨大潜力。

title: Ramp, Plateau, and Wormholes without Averaging, and Hyper-non-perturbative Structures in Gravity
summary:
Universal hallmarks of quantum chaos---such as the ramp and plateau in the spectral form factor---and the ramp's gravitational duals involving wormholes are widely interpreted as consequences of spectral or ensemble averaging. In this paper, following an earlier proposal of~\cite{Liu25c}, we develop an alternative approach: these phenomena arise as macroscopic smooth structures hidden within erratic microscopic data, which can be isolated through a smooth filter projection. Using the semiclassical Gutzwiller trace formula as a paradigmatic example, we illustrate how many features characteristic of random matrix models---including the ramp, the plateau, the spectral curve, and single-eigenvalue instantons---can be derived in the semiclassical limit without invoking ensemble or explicit spectral averages.
  We postulate the existence of a minimal Gutzwiller-like structure in the large-$N$ limit of holographic systems and explore its consequences. Beyond deriving the ramp and the plateau, this Gutzwiller-like structure predicts universal rapid macroscopic oscillations in the density of states and the possible existence of hyper-instantons, both of which involve double exponentials in $1/N^2$.
  On the gravity side, we demonstrate how spacetime wormholes enable the construction of emergent hyper-non-perturbative objects---such as baby-universe and wormhole condensates---which yield double exponential effects in $G_N$. This mirrors the postulated boundary Gutzwiller-like structure and provides a dual gravitational derivation of the universal rapid macroscopic oscillations in the density of states and the spectral plateau.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种替代方法：量子混沌的标志性现象（如谱型因子中的ramp和plateau）并非源于系综或谱平均，而是微观不规则数据中隐藏的宏观光滑结构，可通过光滑滤波投影来分离。作者以半经典Gutzwiller迹公式为例，展示了无需平均即可推导出随机矩阵模型的特征；并推测全息系统大N极限中存在最小Gutzwiller-like结构，预测了态的密度中普遍的快速宏观振荡和超瞬子（双重指数效应），同时在引力侧论证了时空虫洞如何构建这些超非微扰对象。
AI.motivation: 量子混沌的通用特征（如谱型因子中的ramp与plateau）及其引力对偶（虫洞）通常被解释为谱平均或系综平均的结果。作者希望提出一种替代框架：这些现象本质上是隐藏在随机微观数据中的宏观光滑结构，可以通过滤波投影提取，而不需要引入任何平均过程。这在概念上可能更贴合AdS/CFT等全息框架中单一量子系统的谱。
AI.method: 论文以半经典Gutzwiller迹公式为范例，发展光滑滤波投影方法，从微观无规谱数据中分离出宏观光滑结构，进而推导出ramp、plateau、谱曲线和单本征值瞬子等随机矩阵特征。作者进一步假设全息系统大N极限中存在最小Gutzwiller-like结构，并从引力侧通过虫洞构建婴儿宇宙和虫洞凝聚体，产生双重指数效应，从而与边界侧的推测形成对偶。
AI.result: 在半经典极限下，无需系综或谱平均即可推导出随机矩阵理论的典型特征（ramp、plateau、谱曲线、单本征值瞬子）。Gutzwiller-like结构进一步预测了态密度中的快速宏观振荡和可能的超瞬子，两者都涉及1/N^2中的双重指数效应。在引力侧，时空虫洞构建的婴儿宇宙和虫洞凝聚体产生G_N中的双重指数效应，与边界预测一致。
AI.conclusion: 论文建立了量子混沌通用特征的一种非平均化理论框架，表明ramp和plateau等可作为半经典极限下宏观光滑滤波的产物。全息对偶表明，边界侧的Gutzwiller-like结构与引力侧的虫洞构建的超非微扰对象（如虫洞凝聚体）在双重指数层面上相互呼应，为态密度快速宏观振荡和谱plateau提供了统一的引力推导。

title: Magneto-oscillations, nonlinearity, and nonreciprocity of Coulomb drag in quantum circuits
summary: We consider the problem of Coulomb drag in interactively coupled quantum circuits built of adiabatic constrictions: quantum point contacts and short quantum-wire channels. The interplay of spatial confinement and magnetic field leads to a rich oscillatory response of the drag current as a function of gate voltage and magnetic field: drag peaks track the depopulation of magnetoelectric subbands, are asymptotically periodic in inverse field, and their visibility is controlled by the competition of temperature with the field-sharpened tunneling width of the constriction. We derive a closed expression for the linear drag conductance whose interaction kernel simplifies dramatically in the experimentally relevant limit of a long thermal length compared with the range of the interwire coupling, investigate the drag in the nonlinear regime, where the drag current measures the transconductance of the drive channel at any field, and discuss physically motivated models of dissipation-induced nonreciprocity of the drag signal. Extensions accounting for Zeeman splitting, interaction renormalization of the barrier transmission, backscattering at high field, and the frequency structure of the circuit coupling delineate how each mechanism imprints itself on the temperature dependence and lineshapes of the drag oscillations.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了由绝热收缩结构（量子点接触和短量子线通道）组成的相互作用耦合量子电路中的库仑拖拽问题，推导出了线性拖拽电导的闭式表达式，并探讨了非线性区域、耗散诱导的非互易性以及磁场、温度等多种因素对拖拽振荡的影响。
AI.motivation: 理解在空间限制和磁场共同作用下，量子电路中的库仑拖拽现象及其丰富的振荡响应特性，这对于基础量子输运研究和潜在器件应用具有重要意义。
AI.method: 通过解析方法推导线性拖拽电导的闭式表达式，在热长度远大于线间耦合范围的实验相关极限下简化相互作用核；分析非线性区域的拖拽电流（可测量驱动通道的跨导）；并纳入塞曼劈裂、相互作用重正化、高场背散射和电路耦合频率结构等物理机制进行系统性研究。
AI.result: 发现拖拽峰跟踪磁电子子带的去居组过程，在逆磁场中呈渐近周期性；拖拽振荡的可见性由温度与场加宽的收缩隧穿宽度之间的竞争控制；在特定极限下相互作用核可显著简化；拖拽电流在非线性区域可测量驱动通道的跨导。
AI.conclusion: 论文系统描绘了各物理机制（塞曼劈裂、相互作用重正化、高场背散射、耦合频率结构）如何影响拖拽振荡的温度依赖性和线形，为量子电路中的库仑拖拽现象提供了完整的理论图景。

title: Topological Recursion and Quantum Path Signatures
summary: We introduce a non-commutative Laplace transform between functionals on path space and formal series in a tensor algebra, under which a natural convolution of path functionals becomes an algebraic product of series. Applying it to a random unitary matrix-valued path development - the quantum path signature - we show that the governing planar loop equations take a non-commutative spectral form. We then extend the loop equations to a $1/N$ genus expansion, organised by topological recursion, and obtain a hierarchy of integral equations on path space for the corrections.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种路径泛函的非交换拉普拉斯变换，将路径空间上的卷积转化为张量代数中形式级数的代数乘积，并将其应用于随机酉矩阵值路径发展（量子路径签名），得到平面回路方程的非交换谱形式，进而扩展到1/N属展开，由拓扑递归组织，获得路径空间上修正项的积分方程层次。
AI.motivation: 传统拉普拉斯变换将卷积变为乘积，但在路径空间上缺乏对应的非交换框架。作者希望建立一种非交换拉普拉斯变换，使路径泛函的卷积与张量代数中的形式级数相乘建立对应关系，从而为量子路径签名及其回路方程提供新的代数工具。
AI.method: （1）定义非交换拉普拉斯变换，将路径泛函映射到张量代数中的形式级数；（2）证明该变换将路径泛函的自然卷积变为级数乘法（代数乘积）；（3）将此变换应用于随机酉矩阵值路径发展（量子路径签名）；（4）推导出平面回路方程的非交换谱形式；（5）进一步将回路方程扩展到1/N属展开，采用拓扑递归进行组织；（6）得到路径空间上各阶修正项的积分方程层次。
AI.result: 成功建立了非交换拉普拉斯变换与张量代数形式级数之间的对应关系；获得了量子路径签名控制的平面回路方程的非交换谱形式；并将其推广到1/N属展开，通过拓扑递归获得路径空间上修正项的积分方程层级结构。
AI.conclusion: 非交换拉普拉斯变换为路径泛函分析提供了新的工具，量子路径签名的回路方程可被系统地表述为非交换谱形式，并可通过属展开和拓扑递归得到完整修正层次，建立了随机矩阵理论与路径空间微积分之间的深层联系。

title: TNASS: Tensor Network Active Space Selection with the Entanglement Feature
summary: The quality of multi-scale modelling techniques in molecular electronic structure calculations, such as embedding and subspace methods, relies upon the chosen active space. The automation of active space selection is vital for ensuring the accuracy, reproducibility, and scalability in such calculations. In this work, we introduce Tensor Network Active Space Selection using the Entanglement Feature. Through the isolation of strongly correlated electrons, this method provides a scalable foundation for embedding methods in multi-scale modelling. By representing the purities of all possible orbital partitions as a Matrix Product State, our method isolates regions of strong electron correlation without requiring manual preselection of target atoms or the calculation of expensive high-order density matrices. The results demonstrate that this approach leads to lower ground state energies and more accurate dipole moments than other fully automated selection schemes such as those based solely on single-orbital entropy or the selection of spatial orbitals around the HOMO/LUMO gap.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于纠缠特征和张量网络的自动活性空间选择方法（TENSES），通过将轨道划分的纯度表示为矩阵乘积态来隔离强关联电子区域，无需人工预选目标原子或计算高阶密度矩阵，在基态能量和偶极矩方面优于其他全自动选择方案。
AI.motivation: 多尺度分子电子结构计算（如嵌入法和子空间法）的质量依赖于所选的活性空间，而活性空间选择的自动化对确保计算精度、可复现性和可扩展性至关重要。现有方法要么需要人工预选目标原子，要么需要昂贵的计算资源。
AI.method: 该方法通过将所有可能轨道划分的纯度表示为矩阵乘积态（MPS），从而隔离强电子关联区域。它利用纠缠特征来自动选择活性空间，避免了人工预选目标原子和计算高阶密度矩阵的高昂代价，为嵌入方法提供了可扩展的基础。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法相比仅基于单轨道熵或围绕HOMO/LUMO能隙选择空间轨道的全自动选择方案，能够获得更低的基态能量和更精确的偶极矩。
AI.conclusion: TENSES方法为多尺度建模中的嵌入方法提供了一个可扩展且全自动的活性空间选择方案，兼顾了精度与计算效率，有望提升此类计算的准确性和可复现性。

title: Quantum Impurities as Probes of Finite-Temperature Fluctuations in Two-Dimensional Bose Gases
summary: Two-dimensional quantum gases provide a distinctive setting in which enhanced thermal fluctuations, finite-size effects, and two-body bound-state formation are intrinsically intertwined. In this work, we study a single attractive impurity immersed in a finite, weakly interacting two-dimensional Bose gas, where finite size stabilizes a nonzero condensate fraction by introducing an infrared momentum scale, thereby enabling a Bogoliubov description of the bath. Using a hybrid approach that combines finite-temperature many-body scattering theory with input from path-integral Monte Carlo, we analyze the impurity quasiparticle energy across the condensate and normal regimes. The infrared scale generates a phonon-activation temperature below which the impurity energy remains nearly temperature independent. Once the resolved phonon modes become thermally populated, their contribution competes with condensate depletion, producing a nonmonotonic temperature dependence of the polaron energy. These results suggest that attractive Bose polarons may serve as sensitive probes of finite-size thermal fluctuations, phonon dressing, and bound-state physics in low-dimensional Bose gases.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了沉浸在有界弱相互作用二维玻色气体中的单个吸引杂质（玻色极化子），发现红外动量尺度引入的声子激活温度使杂质能量在低温下几乎与温度无关，而当声子模式热激发后，其贡献与凝聚体耗损竞争导致极化子能量的非单调温度依赖关系。
AI.motivation: 二维量子气体中增强的热涨落、有限尺寸效应和两体束缚态形成内在交织，为理解玻色极化子的准粒子性质提供了独特平台。作者希望阐明有限尺寸效应对杂质准粒子能量的影响，并探索吸引玻色极化子作为探测低维玻色气体中有限尺寸热涨落、声子缀饰和束缚态物理的灵敏探针。
AI.method: 采用混合方法：将有限温度多体散射理论与路径积分蒙特卡洛输入相结合，利用Bogoliubov描述有限体系中由红外动量尺度稳定化的非零凝聚分数，系统分析杂质准粒子能量在凝聚态和正常态两个区域中的行为。
AI.result: 发现红外尺度产生一个声子激活温度：低于该温度时杂质能量几乎与温度无关；一旦解析的声子模式被热激发，其贡献与凝聚体耗损相互竞争，导致极化子能量随温度呈现非单调变化。
AI.conclusion: 吸引玻色极化子可作为低维玻色气体中有限尺寸热涨落、声子缀饰及束缚态物理的灵敏探测工具，为实验上观测这些现象提供了理论依据。

title: Controllable interaction between photons and distant spins via vacuum Rabi oscillations
summary: Vacuum Rabi oscillations between a single photon and a single spin demonstrate the capability of harnessing light-matter interaction at the level of a single quantum of energy. Since the observation of strong spin-photon coupling in gate-defined quantum dots, probing this interaction in the time-domain has been a major objective. Here, we carefully engineer a device composed of two spatially separated double quantum dots hosting single electron spin qubits and a superconducting cavity to accommodate microwave photons. We observe multiple vacuum Rabi oscillations between each spin qubit and the cavity. By concatenating vacuum Rabi oscillations involving the two spins, an energy excitation in one qubit can be emitted as a photon and then transferred to the other qubit. When a single photon is emitted, the cavity is prepared in a Fock state, leading to an accelerated vacuum Rabi frequency. These results serve as building blocks not only in exploring light-matter interactions, but also in interfacing semiconductor spin qubits to photonic links.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了一种由两个空间分离的双量子点自旋量子比特与超导腔组成的器件，观察到每个自旋量子比特与腔之间的多次真空拉比振荡，并通过拼接这些振荡实现能量从一个量子比特到另一个量子比特的传递，制备了Fock态腔。
AI.motivation: 在栅定义量子点中观察到强自旋-光子耦合之后，在时域中探测这种相互作用一直是一个重要目标。在单个能量量子级别揭示光-物质相互作用的潜力，需要观察到可控的真空拉比振荡及量子比特间的信息传递。
AI.method: 精心设计并制造了一个由两个空间分离的双量子点（各容纳一个单电子自旋量子比特）和容纳微波光子的超导腔组成的器件，通过拼接涉及两个自旋的真空拉比振荡，实现能量激励在量子比特间的光子介导传递。
AI.result: 观察到每个自旋量子比特与腔之间的多次真空拉比振荡。当单光子发射时，腔被制备在Fock态，表现出加速的真空拉比频率；能量激励可从一个自旋量子比特发射为光子并传递到另一个量子比特。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果为探索光-物质相互作用提供了基础模块，也为将半导体自旋量子比特与光子链路接口连接打下了基础。

title: Joint spectral characterization of SPDC photon pairs near 2 $μ$m in (Al)GaAs-on-insulator waveguides
summary: Integrated photon-pair sources are a core component of chip-based quantum computing, communication, and metrology. Although such sources have been demonstrated at conventional telecom wavelengths, the 2 $μ$m band remains comparatively less explored, despite offering advantages for free-space quantum communication, low-loss transmission in emerging fiber networks, and integration with silicon photonic platforms. In this paper, we demonstrate spontaneous parametric down-conversion (SPDC) in straight GaAs- and AlGaAs-on-insulator waveguides. This platform offers strong second-order nonlinearity and geometry-tunable dispersion, which are advantageous for efficient on-chip pair generation. Measurements of the joint spectral intensity and heralded second-order correlation function show broadband emission around 2 $μ$m with strong spectral anti-correlations. To our knowledge, this is the first direct joint-spectral characterization of an integrated SPDC source in this wavelength regime.

AI.tldr: 本文在GaAs和AlGaAs-on-insulator直波导中实现了自发参量下转换（SPDC），产生了中心波长约2 μm的宽带光子对，并通过联合光谱强度和谐振二阶相关函数测量表征了其强光谱反关联特性。这是该波段集成SPDC源的首次直接联合光谱表征。
AI.motivation: 集成光子对源是芯片级量子计算、通信和计量的核心组件。虽然传统电信波段的此类源已广泛实现，但2 μm波段因其在自由空间量子通信、新兴光纤网络中的低损耗传输以及与硅光子平台集成的优势而值得研究，但该波段目前探索较少。
AI.method: 在直GaAs和AlGaAs-on-insulator波导中实现自发参量下转换（SPDC）。该平台具有强二阶非线性和几何可调色散，有利于片上高效光子对产生。通过联合光谱强度和谐振二阶相关函数测量进行表征。
AI.result: 测量结果显示在2 μm附近有宽带发射，且光子对具有强光谱反关联特性。这是该波长范围内集成SPDC源的首次直接联合光谱表征。
AI.conclusion: GaAs/AlGaAs-on-insulator平台成功展示了2 μm波段的集成SPDC光子对源，为该波段在自由空间量子通信、低损耗光纤传输和硅光子集成等应用中的量子光源发展奠定了基础。
